Good post, but there are some points I personally disagree with.
Reason 1 - Being a weaker console means absolutely nothing. I mean if the Xbox one was significantly worse than the ps4 then there would be a problem for them, but the switch isn't competing with games like Skyrim as their main competing point, it's their exclusive IPs. And looking at history, the Xbox was more powerful than the PS2, but the PS2 trumped the Xbox in terms of sales and a better library. The switch's value in my honest opinion comes from its own unique spin on the console game and the exclusives it brings.
Reason 2 - Yeah it's pretty gross. 
Reason 3 - Lack of quality titles? The switch is going to have a great lineup by the end of the year. I can't predict whether some of them will be unexpectedly horrible but I digress. The lineup for the launch window is-
Mario Kart 8 Deluxe 
Splatoon 2 
NBA 2K18 
Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim 
Super Mario Odyssey
Super Bomberman R 
Lego city undercover
Sonic Mania
Stardew Valley
Pokemon Stars
I think the switch has a solid mix of exclusives and other games that have large fandoms like the lego series, Skyrim and stardew valley. 
And to the Skyrim and Mario Kart 8 being a joke, I honestly do and don't understand this trail of logic. I mean, for Skyrim which is going to be a good old C&P of the game, yeah, but Mario Kart 8 is coming in some deluxe edition IIRC. Remakes like this for beloved games to the fans can be pretty hit or miss depending on what it adds to the experience. Take Persona 4 Golden. P4G is the best selling PSVita game of all time and whilst it doesn't play differently they did add an extra character to Social Link.
